notes.title: 属实刺激！
notes.content:
相信很多人都已经用了奇奇怪怪的，难以言表的方式获得了《告死天使之言》，
本次事件纯属意外情况，就当是黑妖和寒十给大家拜个早年！（万圣节福利）
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35516649/ea3a29aefcc42ac3a383c966438bb761b7fe3ac1.jpg[/img]

《告死天使之言》是寒十15岁制作完成的独立游戏。
作品里面难免有很多不成熟的地方，希望领取到游戏的玩家可以试玩一下，给点短评，无论好评差评都可以。
当然也欢迎建议和意见，或者是对她未来作品的题材取向。
如果喜欢寒十妹妹的作品，也可以购买《告死天使之言》的DLC，或者《告死天使的审判》支持一下。
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16200/_/


另外黑妖刚刚发售了代理的《迅风的米斯特汀》和自研《恶灵退散》，也欢迎大家加一下愿望单关注一下。
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1289830/_Windy_Mystletainn/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1600890/_Go_Back_to_Hell/

以及即将发布的《怕不怕趴喵霸霸》
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1600900/_Ghost_Party_Nyanbaba/

notes.title: Update log: Join achievement system
notes.content:
Fixed possible crash when archiving.

Join steam achievement system. All related achievements are in the main line, which can be obtained through customs clearance. The customs clearance process is about 2 hours.
A new cover has been replaced.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35516649/cdd8d63eb80b5455377ac175ef78c8e14c570dea.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The game will be changed from free to paid.
notes.content:
Change the publisher, change the distribution strategy.

7 days after the announcement of the plan, the fee will be charged. It is expected to be around August 20. The specific time shall be subject to the steam customer service review time.

All players who buy the new movie death angel trial before August 20 will automatically get death angel for free even if they miss it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1269050/Death_ Angel_ Trial/



Players who have already obtained it for free will not be affected. Please get the free version of death angel as soon as possible.



It is planned that death angel will have several minor updates in the near future, such as joining steam achievements.
